Native confirmation key and effective Break scan, fallback open. Proof may accept exact fallback timestamp even if omitted by native start.

findings.detail: TB38 wording could imply native fallback is categorically excluded from proof. Native resolver may return open; proof validates that timestamp alone. With later intrabar start, open may satisfy strict predicate although outside native scan. No substitute event or firstness proof. This is a source-derived conditional case, not an observed RAW result.
Read-only projection may invoke native stop lookup; no new detector or cause creation, not zero search execution. Legacy fields and nested proof have different guards.
